quest.title: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
quest.description: Following Paimon's whim, you return to Inazuma where you encounter an unknown youkai. Intrigued by this small creature, you are drawn into a moonlit encounter...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, remember when we chased that tanuki down this way? Good times!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't think they look anything like that... Oh, maybe there's a new kind of youkai in town?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm.... Is it trying to get us to follow it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that girl doing over there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She doesn't look well... Let's go check on her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What just happened? All we did was lock eyes with her for a split-second, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, where did all these people come from? And what are they here for?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like they're waiting in line for some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: True... Oh, and there's that girl! She's still here. Hmm, maybe she knows what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: If I leave now, will I have enough time?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: How many times do I have to explain?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: There's no going back if I report him. But still...
Hmm... anxiety over a lack of creative inspiration... Well, inspiration tends to give anxious minds a wide berth, so I hope our treatment will help you relax.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: ...Thank you.

...Remorse for the misdeeds of the past, and despair over the sorry state of the present... I can help you face your troubles with a more positive mindset, but you'll need to work through things in your own time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: ...Many thanks.
Next please! *cough*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong with her?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?
I'm fine. Next, please...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um...
Mmm! Delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that was unexpected...
Huh? What do we have here... *burp*! Oh no, I'm so sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry for what? We have no idea what's going on here, let alone what you're sorry for. Would you mind bringing us up to speed?
It looks like you entered my dream by mistake. Let me wake you up, then I'll explain everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dream? When did that—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa...
#Hi! Feeling more awake now? Heh, I never expected {NICKNAME} to literally come to me in a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you know who I am?
Oh, someone I know talks about you all the time. Plus... I'm pretty good at profiling people based on their reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So who are you?
Right, of course. It's our first time meeting each other, so I should introduce myself properly.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: My name is Yumemizuki Mizuki — or just "Mizuki" for short. I'm a yumekui-baku, which is a kind of youkai here in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yumekui-baku?

dialogues.speaker: Little Baku
dialogues.text: *hum*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's that little critter from before...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: That's what we look like in our original form. I'm guessing that's the one that led you into my dream earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Baku feast on the bad dreams of human beings — but we need to be in a dream of our own to digest them. The place where you met me earlier was where I go to digest bad dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I must have swallowed one too many bad dreams, because they were causing me some digestive trouble... It's actually a good thing you showed up when you did.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Call it a happy accident, I guess. Thanks to your help, I'm now able to digest all these dreams properly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we thought you looked a little uncomfortable. That's why we came over. We didn't know what it was, we just thought maybe you could use some help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon really hates bad dreams, so Paimon's even more happy to help knowing that you can eat them!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Thank you... but I still owe you an apology...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: For what?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: While you were inside my dream... I ate one of your dreams, but it wasn't a bad one. It was a nice one.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I've eaten so many bad dreams today that I just scarfed it down without noticing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So yumekui-baku can eat good dreams too, huh... Still, is that really such a big deal?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Of course it is. Dreams are some of the most precious things a person can have, and I just went and gobbled it down...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: It's the unwritten rule of my kind: Never eat someone else's good dreams without permission. I can't believe I was so careless.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: But... Don't you feel horribly depressed? Isn't your mind suddenly flooded with distressing memories?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Remarkable... I've never heard of someone remaining so mentally stable after having a good dream of theirs devoured...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Umm... It's probably because {NICKNAME} has too many good dreams to count!

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Maybe, but I still owe you something for your trouble... Ah! Here, take this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a VIP pass for the Aisa Bathhouse...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Staffed by clinical psychologists and offering spa and fine dining services, we invite you to bring us your troubles and leave refreshed and renewed"...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: That's where I work. You'll find the address on there, too.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: This invitation letter entitles you to enjoy our highest-tier service, free of charge... Oh, and speaking of work — I'd better get back before I'm missed.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Hope to see you as customers soon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So she's a yumekui-baku that eats bad dreams and a clinical psychologist, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's never considered therapy before. Then again, Paimon never really gets that stressed out. Except when she's trying to decide what to eat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of eating — that bathhouse place does fine dining, and we have a VIP pass. That means we can eat as much as we want, right? This is the opportunity of a lifetime! We can't let it go to waste!
